v3 Redesign — May 2026

Blick Group — LinkedIn Card Pair

Wednesday — Educational

Flip from pale infographic to dark editorial. A large typographic question is the scroll-stopper. The technical diagram is rebuilt as a precision engineering drawing — fine white lines and construction geometry on black, labelled in monospace. Feels like a Castrol technical brief or a NOV field guide, not a Canva template. Orange used only where it means something (the friction force, the product callout).

Friday — Product Spotlight

Product photo dominates — 58% of card height, slightly oversized for drama. Radial glow behind the pail echoes premium lubricant brand photography (Castrol Edge, Fuchs Titan). One claim, one spec in orange, nothing else. The hot-pink label and black pail do the visual work — copy just frames it. Accent bar bleeds orange left-to-right from the photo into the text, unifying zones. Real logo, real URL — no chip tags, no body paragraph.
